subject: geography

items.correct: Improvements in wealth, health, education and quality of life.
items.random_wrong: That all countries develop at the same speed.
items.why: Measures like the HDI combine income with life expectancy and education.

items.q: Why do some countries develop faster than others?
items.correct: Many factors: trade, history, resources, conflict, climate and governance.
items.why: Development is shaped by complex physical and human factors, not a single cause.
